points.description: The property is that there is exactly one unique path between every pair of nodes in a spanning tree.
A spanning tree connects all nodes without loops, so no duplicate packets are forwarded when broadcasting or multicasting.
To build multicast trees with link state routing, each link state packet is extended to carry the multicast group membership information of each node.

Once the full topology and group membership are flooded to all nodes, each node locally computes the multicast spanning tree (e.g. using Prim's or Kruskal's algorithm) from its complete copy of the state information.
